checked: Watch topics found: most-read, disasters (Cikande fire, floods, Ibu/Semeru), crime (narkoba), viral (Yudhi sujud), hoaxes
Storylines: Megawati/Listyo-Sigit, Gibran VP replacement, Perampasan Aset

events.event: A fire at the PT Fonusa Agung Mulia candy factory in Pancatama, Cikande, Serang (Banten) killed workers and left dozens missing; the company apologised.
events.key_numbers: Early 22 Nov: 3 dead · 36 missing · 15 safe · 4 injured (police earlier said 42 workers unreachable) · later headlines: 6-7 body bags evacuated, BPBD Serang counts 16 employees safe · cause not stated
events.why_it_matters: Factory-safety failure with a rising death toll hits ordinary workers; the death toll and cause are still moving.
events.spreading_evidence: detik terpopuler #6; CNN Indonesia nasional top 5 headlines; Antara homepage

events.event: Megawati Soekarnoputri said at a STIPAN graduation oration that she will not join the Prabowo government ('Terima kasih, saya di luar saja'), also criticising wiretapping, the police and KPK; PDIP says it was not about the offer being too small.
events.key_numbers: Said 19 Nov, 21:26 WIB · PDIP summoned by police 3 times, by prosecutors once (her account) · reactions from Gerindra and PKB on 22 Nov
events.why_it_matters: Shows whether the largest opposition party will stay outside the government while the VP seat and wiretap case are open.

events.event: Ma'ruf Amin resigned as chair of MUI's Dewan Pertimbangan (Wantim) and kept his decision despite requests to stay; MUI is discussing a successor.
events.key_numbers: Resignation letter dated 23 Dec 2025, processed only the week of 20 Nov 2026 · 2025-2030 term · no successor named yet
events.why_it_matters: A former vice president leaving the country's top clerical body; the reason given is to be closer to the people.

events.event: Kapolri Suyudi Ario Seto said Polri has seized about 600 tons of narcotics in nearly two months and busted an Indonesia-Malaysia network.
events.key_numbers: 600 tons since taking office (~2 months) · 'hundreds of trillions' rupiah (Kapolri) · network: 4 suspects, Madura/Surabaya/Kalimantan · assets ~Rp150 billion seized · Rp2.9 trillion transactions 2018-2024 under TPPU probe
events.why_it_matters: A record-scale claim (600 tons) people will want sanity-checked: what counts, how the weight is measured.
events.spreading_evidence: CNN Indonesia nasional top 10; widely covered by many outlets

events.event: Bengkulu police chief Irjen Yudhi Sulistianto Wahid was moved from his post after his prostration video went viral, in a batch of Kapolres/Kapolda mutations by the Kapolri.
events.key_numbers: Mutation announced 22 Nov · related video viral 21 Nov (E1025) · exact new post not confirmed from headline
events.why_it_matters: Viral behaviour by a senior officer led to a quick consequence.
events.spreading_evidence: CNN Indonesia nasional headlines; detik feed

events.event: Floods hit areas from North Sumatra to West Kalimantan, affecting hundreds of families.
events.key_numbers: 'Ratusan keluarga' affected (no exact figure read) · BMKG heavy-rain warning for Sunday 22 Nov
events.why_it_matters: Rainy-season floods keep spreading across regions.

events.event: Mount Ibu (North Maluku) and Mount Semeru erupted, throwing ash hundreds of metres high.
events.key_numbers: Ibu ash column 400 m · Semeru ash 'hundreds of metres'
events.why_it_matters: Volcano activity affects flights and nearby villages.

events.event: The Kunstkring Paleis monument (Tugu Kunstkring, Jakarta) burned in a pre-dawn fire.
events.key_numbers: Fire pre-dawn 22 Nov · damage/cause not read from headline
events.why_it_matters: A Jakarta heritage landmark damaged by fire.

events.event: DPR figures (Sahroni, Golkar) said leaving illicit enrichment out of the Asset Forfeiture bill was a considered choice and that it is already covered by the Tipikor and TPPU laws.
events.key_numbers: Illicit enrichment excluded from RUU Perampasan Aset (E0954) · Golkar: already regulated in UU Tipikor-TPPU
events.why_it_matters: Decides whether officials with unexplained wealth can have it seized.

events.event: DPD chairman proposed that President Prabowo have three vice presidents and explained the idea on 22 Nov; Yenny Wahid called Dasco capable as VP.
events.key_numbers: Proposal: 3 VPs · MPR plenary to pick new VP set for 9 Dec (E0898)
events.why_it_matters: Changes the VP succession debate from one seat to three.
events.spreading_evidence: CNBC Indonesia latest #5; CNN Indonesia nasional

events.event: TurnBackHoax rated false several viral claims: a video of Prabowo ordering TNI/Polri to follow up demonstrations (actually an August 2025 speech), an AI photo of Jokowi arrested by Brimob, and a claim that Sri Sultan HB X halted MBG in Yogyakarta.
events.key_numbers: Prabowo video: from Aug 2025 speech · Jokowi photo: AI-made · MBG Jogja: 97 SPPG suspended for funding/operational reasons, not Sultan's order
events.why_it_matters: Political hoaxes keep spreading using old footage and AI images.

events.event: Police examined the victim in the alleged rape case against Kupang Regent Yosef Lede.
events.key_numbers: Victim examined 22 Nov · case upgraded to investigation earlier (E0973)
events.why_it_matters: Tests whether the case against a sitting regent proceeds.
